name: @arstzy/nexus-mcp
description: Nexus - Standalone AST Knowledge Graph & Master End-to-End Flow Extraction Engine

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp src/ui/viewer.html dist/ui/viewer.html && mkdir -p dist/wasm && cp node_modules/tree-sitter-wasms/out/tree-sitter-*.wasm dist/wasm/ && cp node_modules/web-tree-sitter/web-tree-sitter.wasm dist/wasm/tree-sitter.wasm && chmod +x dist/index.js dist/mcp/index.js

author: arsyaadi
